articles.title: Neeraj Kumar's fight shifts from Anant to Lalan Singh
articles.summary: After the Bihar MLC elections, Neeraj Kumar has openly criticized Lalan Singh for lack of support. Neeraj Kumar, now victorious, met with party leaders to express gratitude for their assistance. He emphasized that he will not seek blessings from Lalan Singh in the future. Additionally, Kumar is advocating for leadership under Nishant Kumar, the son of Nitish Kumar.

articles.title: IPB inks deals worth Rs 8,000 crore at Vibrant Goa summit
articles.summary: The Goa Investment Promotion Board (IPB) signed nine MoUs worth Rs 8,600 crore at the Vibrant Goa Global Business Summit, chief minister Pramod Sawant said on Saturday. He said the investment proposals could generate 5,000 jobs across artificial intelligence (AI), data centres, hospitality, energy, logistics, healthcare and other industrial sectors.

articles.title: BIT Patna Hosts Annual Cultural Festival ‘Jhalak 2026’, Bringing Campus Alive With Chhath
articles.summary: Patna : The campus of the Birla Institute of Technology (BIT), Patna , came alive with music, dance, literature and cultural performances on Saturday as the institute’s cultural committee, Pratibimb, inaugurated its annual cultural festival, ‘Jhalak 2026’ . articles.title: EPFO news: Pensioners can submit digital life certificates from home during November
articles.summary: Pensioners covered under the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) may no longer need to visit an Employees' Provident Fund Organisation ( EPFO ) office to submit their annual life certificates. The EPFO's regional office in Agra is preparing to spread awareness about digital facilities that allow pensioners to complete the process using a smartphone .

articles.title: Bihar’s Akanksha Hostels Gain Popularity Among Working Women, All Seats Filled in Patna

articles.title: Pakistan equal India's historic Lord's chase record, clinch ODI tri-nation series
articles.summary: Chasing a daunting 326 at the Gaddafi Stadium, Pakistan rode on a magnificent century from Fakhar Zaman and crucial contributions from Saad Baig and Arafat Minhas to seal the title with nine balls to spare. The victory also saw Pakistan equal India's historic record for the highest successful run chase in an ODI tournament final.

articles.title: Student activists march in Patna to condemn mob rule and defend democracy
articles.summary: Members of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad held a protest march in Patna on Friday to condemn mob rule and defend constitutional institutions. Led by national secretary Abhay Pratap Singh and Delhi University Students Union President Yash Dabas, the demonstrators marched toward Dak Bungalow Chauraha. They urged youth to protect democratic values against attempts to weaken governance through anarchy.
